== Overview ==

'''RemoteLogDeviceProtocol''' is a simple protocol that provides developers a way to send game logs to a remote server rather than logging them locally.

== Methods ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Method ID !! Name
|-
| 1 || [[#Log]]
|}

=== Log ===

Sends a log line to the remote server.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[Online/Nintendo_Network/NEX/Types#String|String]] || strLine || The log line to send to the remote server
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.
